description: List the project's translation tasks on the branches this token may use: title, status, type, branch, due date, scope and progress (how many scoped values are translated, QA-clean and approved). Open work by default. Progress is cached: `computedAt` says how fresh it is, and it is null until the first count.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

status.description: open, in_progress, completed, cancelled, a comma list of those, or "all". Default: open and in_progress.

name: list_tasks
title: List Tasks
